outlook.statement: The Company remained focused on maintaining financial discipline, preserving liquidity, managing working capital and strengthening the foundations for sustainable growth.

The Company's medium- to long-term outlook remains cautiously positive, notwithstanding near-term operating challenges. India's structural consumption opportunity remains attractive. Management's objective is to strengthen the Company's core franchise while creating a more scalable and sustainable platform for future growth.

For FY 2026-27, management intends to focus on: Revenue - Rebuild sustainable top-line growth; Product - Increase differentiated and value-added offerings; Brand - Strengthen PearlPET's consumer proposition; Distribution - Expand digital and organised retail presence; Costs - Improve operating efficiency; Working Capital - Strengthen receivables and inventory management; Innovation - Accelerate consumer-led product development; Sustainability - Improve material efficiency and recyclability; Financial Discipline - Preserve liquidity and maintain debt-free position.
